How to play
  • Your ship aims at the nearest enemy automatically. You decide when to fire. Every projectile costs 1 ammo: you start with 32 and can carry 80.
  • Your ammo controls the next volley: 1–16 fires 1 bullet, 17–32 fires 2, 33–48 fires 3, 49–64 fires 4, and 65–80 fires 5. Twin adds one extra bullet when you have enough ammo. The Volley indicator updates as you spend or gain rounds.
  • Your reactor creates 1 new round every half-second while you have fewer than 32. It works even with no bullets or pickups around. Stop firing to rebuild your reserve; magnets and recovered shots can fill the larger 80-round capacity. Recharge pauses with the game.
  • Pulse shots are used up on impact. Piercer and Twin can pass through 3 enemies; Nova explodes on impact. Shots that cross an edge return from the opposite side, slow and live. Live shots grow stronger each lap and hurt you on contact.
  • Grab a magnet (cyan horseshoe with an M). For 6 seconds its ring pulls every live shot inside it into your ship, from any angle. Shots in the field cannot hurt you then, but enemies still can.
  • Each magnet also brings a +8 ammo supply bonus. A new magnet resets the timer to 6 seconds; it does not stack.
  • Every recovered shot gives +1 ammo and +1 upgrade progress: 24 unlocks Piercer, 96 Twin, 240 Nova. Progress is cumulative throughout the run.
  • Magnets arrive about every 12 seconds. Stay below 8 ammo for a second and an emergency magnet appears and waits for you. Your reactor keeps supplying ammo while you reach it.
  • Green aid kits (+25 energy) arrive while you are hurt. Taking a hit clears the live shots around you.
  • Enemies get tougher every 45 seconds. New threats arrive sooner: tanks after 30 seconds, weavers after 60, dashers after 90, and splitters after 120. Watch a dasher's yellow warning line before it charges.
Blue: your fresh shots, safe Purple: live shots, they hurt Cyan ring: magnet field Red ring: about to hit you Horseshoe: magnet, +8 ammo Green box: aid kit, +25 energy

Phone: drag the movement pad and hold FIRE. You can also use the left and right halves of the arena.
Keyboard: WASD or arrows move, hold Space or click to fire, P or Esc pauses, Enter starts.
